name: Ikinari H -Hitomi ga Atta Dake de Yokujou Chouhatsu Soku Hame-

source:
"We only want your body... The whiteness inside you."

It turns out that "white stuff" is a princess dwelling inside me. Because of her I've got freeloading witches living in my house trying to get her out.

At any given moment things I'm assailed by madness.
Uh, what's her name... Miss Crazy! She's always harassing me and jamming me up.
In the middle of that... Miss Crisis? Her rampant magic shrinks my body.

Add to that an evil power that causes women's moods to flip with just a little bit of eye contact...

Welcome to my instant f*ck menstrual lustful life.

“我们只想要你的身体……你内心的白色。”

在任何特定的时刻，我都会被疯狂袭击。
呃，她叫什么名字……疯狂小姐！她总是骚扰我、骚扰我。
就在这中间……危机小姐？她猖獗的魔法使我的身体缩小。

欢迎来到我即时的经期淫荡生活。
